title: Vietnam Garment Line Production
thesis: Snowflake turns daily line data from a synthetic network of Vietnamese garment cutting, sewing and packing lines into plan-attainment KPIs, 7-day stoppage-risk scores, throughput gap anomalies and grounded AI answers, all on curated dynamic tables.

talking_points: Plan attainment, line stoppages, queue hours per piece and pieces released for 28 garment lines across 5 Vietnamese cities.
Every KPI is a numerator over a denominator in a curated dynamic table, so it can be traced back to line-day rows.
The shortfall chart shows which stoppage causes cost the most committed pieces; late fabric deliveries lead.
tabs.call_out: One governed set of line production KPIs, traceable to source rows

transition.line: Which lines are likely to stop next?

talking_points: Snowflake ML classification scores each line's probability of a stoppage in the next 7 days.
The holdout line shows precision and recall on the most recent labelled days, against the base rate; the lift over the base rate is small and recall is low, so treat the score as triage.
Anomaly detection flags throughput gap outliers per line, and the forecast projects network-wide plan attainment for 14 days.
tabs.call_out: Honest, evaluated ML inside the data platform

transition.line: How many backup machines sit behind those risks?

talking_points: Line availability and backup machine coverage show how much room each line has when a machine goes down.
PM compliance against plan attainment by line shows where the two move together; it is an association, not proof of cause.
The action memo drafts three prioritised actions from the KPI, stoppage, cause and risk tables only.
show: Line availability and backup machine coverage
tabs.call_out: Grounded draft actions, with a human in the loop

transition.line: What happens when a sewing line alarms right now?

talking_points: Live sewing-line controller messages land in RAW.LIVE_TELEMETRY, from the simulator or from AWS IoT Core through Snowpipe.
The Snowflake alert logs ALARM readings with an SOP hint and the line's current risk band, then emails the line planner.
tabs.call_out: From line alarm to action in one platform

talking_points: The Cortex Agent uses Cortex Analyst over the semantic view for metrics, and Cortex Search over synthetic line stoppage SOPs.
Each answer shows the generated SQL and the SOPs it cited.

transition.line: Here is how it is built.

talking_points: Two builds share one core: Snowflake only, or AWS + Snowflake (IoT Core, Bedrock, QuickSight and Amazon Q).
Everything shown is synthetic demo data, rebuilt reproducibly from the repo.
tabs.call_out: One governed core, with an optional AWS edge
